description: Built full-stack ML platforms for internal tooling and client engagements. Led development of the EY ML Playground, a no-code machine learning platform covering the full pipeline — data ingestion, audit, feature selection, model training/tuning, and results visualization — supporting Regression, Forecasting, and Classification model families. Also built OpEx Studio, a forecasting application for a Takeda×EY consulting engagement using DTW-based model routing across ARIMA, SARIMA, Prophet, LSTM, and LightGBM.
points: Architected EY ML Playground: full-pipeline no-code ML platform for automated data audit, feature engineering, and model tuning.
Engineered OpEx Studio for Takeda×EY engagement: implemented dynamic DTW model routing across time-series forecasting models (ARIMA, Prophet, LightGBM).

description: Developed custom SAP ABAP solutions, enhanced enterprise data processing workflows, and implemented customized business logic for client ERP transformation projects.
points: Engineered custom ABAP Reports (ALV Grid & Interactive Reports) using Open SQL to optimize enterprise data extraction and financial auditing.
Designed and customized SAP Smart Forms and SAPscript layouts for automated enterprise documentation and invoice generation.
Implemented User Exits, BAdIs (Business Add-Ins), and Enhancement Spots to extend standard SAP ERP module functionalities without modifying core source code.
Utilized BAPIs (Business Application Programming Interfaces) and RFCs for secure data exchange between SAP ERP backend and external systems.
Performed SQL performance tuning, code optimization, and root-cause analysis using SAP ABAP Workbench & Debugging tools (SE80, ST05, SAT).
